data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 68.5m (2014: GBP 83.1m) is an improvement of GBP 9.0m (2014: improvement of GBP 6.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to beneficial developments in prior year reserves across the Marine and Transport classes.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 Syndicate 1861 held opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 224.779m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows an aggregate prior-year release of approximately GBP 4.9m (gross), driven by favourable development principally in the older Marine/Transport underwriting years (2011-2013) and aided by a generally benign catastrophe season. The Managing Agent reports a net improvement of GBP 9.0m within net claims incurred (after reinsurance).
raw_causal_phrases: improvement of GBP 9.0m (2014: improvement of GBP 6.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end
beneficial developments in prior year reserves across the Marine and Transport classes

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was not stated explicitly as a single gross line in the movement note; a net favourable development of GBP 9.0m (after reinsurance) is reported in narrative. The gross prior-year development figure (-GBP 4.908m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross basis). Confidence is moderate-high for the triangle calculation (0.8). No RITC distortion was identified in the notes.
